about.statement: A creative house for events, brands and the ideas in between. One team plans it, builds it, prints it and launches it.
about.body: Our base is Dubai, and our work runs across six markets, from Saudi Arabia to Egypt: an airline's pavilion at the Dubai Airshow, a majlis dressed for a heritage welcome, a bilingual app for a national sports federation. Each idea starts where the brand meets its audience, and one team carries it through strategy, creative, production and delivery.

meta.title: Styleguide
meta.description: Colour, type, space, motion and components for the NO TIME Creative House website.

intro.lead: Colour, type, space, motion and the components built from them. Every page of the site is assembled from what is on this one.

colour.selected: {hex} is selected. Copy it with your keyboard.

espresso.name: Deep Espresso
espresso.role: Dark section backgrounds, primary text on light.

cocoa.name: Cocoa Brown
cocoa.role: Secondary text and hover states on light.

champagne.name: Champagne Beige
champagne.role: Primary buttons and highlights on dark.

ivory.name: Vanilla Ivory
ivory.role: Light section backgrounds, text on dark.

type.headingKey: Bold for the word that matters.

samples.lead: From the first concept sketch to the last guest leaving, one team carries the idea, so nothing is lost between suppliers.
samples.body: Body copy stays calm and readable. Lines are held near 65 characters, and Arabic is set one step larger, so both languages carry the same visual weight on the page.

shape.radiusNote: 4px is the default for buttons, cards and fields. Tags use 2px.

micro.name: Micro
micro.desc: Buttons, links and toggles. Owned by Motion.

base.name: Base
base.desc: Section and card reveals. Owned by GSAP.

stagger.name: Stagger
stagger.desc: The gap between letters or words in a reveal.

components.link: Text link with an underline that draws in
components.labelsNote: “Illustrative” sits on any AI image that stands in for a real project. “Preview” marks concept screens of products still in development.
components.emailError: Add the domain after the @, for example {example}
components.categoriesNote: On a computer, a card opens when you hover over it or tab to it. On a phone, the card in view opens as you scroll.

patterns.lead: Small marks that hold the pages together. Each has one job, and none of them is the point.

hairline.name: Hairline
hairline.do: Divide lists and close section heads.
hairline.dont: Box content in, or stack two rules.

corners.name: Frame corners
corners.do: Mark one featured image per section, like a crop mark.
corners.dont: Frame every card, or put them around text.

geometric.name: Gulf pattern
geometric.do: Texture a dark section at 4%, behind everything.
geometric.dont: Use it on light sections, or raise it until it reads as a picture.

leak.name: Light leak
leak.do: Warm one corner of a dark section.
leak.dont: Use more than one per section, or put it behind body text.

tick.name: Clock ticks
tick.do: Lead a section eyebrow. The hand points at the section's place on the page.
tick.dont: Use it as a loader, or twice in one section.

kenBurns.name: Slow push-in
kenBurns.do: Move slowly into a still while it crosses the screen.
kenBurns.dont: Combine it with parallax on the same image.

sweep.name: Hover sweep
sweep.do: Cross a card's image once when the mouse arrives.
sweep.dont: Loop it, or show it on touch screens.

duotone.name: Duotone
duotone.do: Unify Work card images. The colour returns on hover.
duotone.dont: Use it on the hero or on product screenshots.

divider.name: Marquee divider
divider.do: Join two sections with words already on the page.
divider.dont: Put new information in it: screen readers skip it.

closing.body: Every section of the site will be assembled from the colours, type, spacing and motion on this page.
